# Seconds each host KAT took on a GitHub ubuntu-latest runner, one suite at a time. plan.py uses
# these only to balance the shards; a suite missing here is planned at its default weight and still
# runs, so a new suite needs no entry.
#
# Seeded 2026-11-10. 180 suites: the core repo's .github/kat-shards/timings.txt as it stood (the
# larger of core CI runs 40443136599 and 40404448022, single-job sweeps of 2026-10-26/27). The 29
# suites that file did not have: the largest of core CI runs 42930445886 and 42919547457 (their
# kat-timings artifacts) and this repo's CI run 42923861836 (from its log's timestamps).
#
# To refresh, replace the lines below with the kat-timings artifact of a recent green CI run's
# `build` job (it is this file's format). The same suite varies up to twofold between runners, so
# refresh when the shards have drifted apart, not after every run.
